title: Changing Tides of PG
body:
Members: 11Formed: September 2022Goal: “Our goal is to encourage youths and other members of the community to be environmental stewards. We plan to bring more awareness about the importance of our environment and how we can live more sustainably as a community to conserve it.” – President Luani Rodriguez. 

Major Accomplishments:

 1.) Conducted coastal clean-up along Punta Gorda2.) Participated and competed in “A Challenge to Re-imagine Conservation” TIDE exhibition3.) Assisted with the Save the Seaside Park Project4.) Represented TIDE and Youths of Toledo in national and local forums on Climate Change and Spotlight Initiative.Follow them at : https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100086175982299
